Name: Wizardry - A magical skill mod
Author: MoonSlime
AuthorLabel: Moon Slime for porting - spacechase0 the original mod author
Description:
[size=3]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]First, get 2 hearts from the Wizard (5 hearts with SVE to fit into it's storyline). You will then have a cutscene with the wizard in he unlocked your magical potential, which will take 1 day (GO TO SLEEP). After that, go to Yoba's altar in Pierre's shop to change your spells. To learn you spells, you need to analyze objects, places, and maybe even people! Can you collect all 40 spells?[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Gain spells by using the Analyze spell from the arcane school. Get hints on where to find spells from the radio in the wizard's tower[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Gain exp from casting spells![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Enchant and Disenchant which lets you increase item's quality, which helps with inventory problems![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Remote Grabbing/Harvesting of machines! no need to walk all the way to them[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Charm friends with your magic, increasing your friendship with them at the cost of health[/size][/*]
[*]and more![/*]
[/list]
NEW IN v1.9.0
[list]
[*]The Dwarf now sells Dwarf scrolls once you reach 5 friendship with him (important for later)[/*]
[*][b][i][u]SPELL SCROLL CRAFTING![/u][/i][/b][/*]
[*]Traveling Cart now sells 1-4 spell scrolls at a 20% chance[/*]
[*]Can learn spells by analyzing spell scrolls[/*]
[*]Learn how to craft the spell scroll of X spell by learning the spell![/*]
[*]Crafting spell scrolls takes mana rocks + dwarven scrolls + the item used to cast the spell (if it takes an item).[/*]
[*]Use the spell scrolls to cast the level 0 version of spells without using mana or items, but gain no exp.[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][i]CONTROLS:[/i][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][u][b][i]Q[/i][/b][/u] is a modifier for this mod[/*]
[*][u][b][i]Q+Tab[/i][/b][/u] Changes your spell page[/*]
[*][b][i][u]Q+1[/u] [/i][/b]Uses your first spell[/*]
[*][b][i][u]Q+2[/u][/i][/b] Uses your second spell[/*]
[*][u][i][b]Q+3[/b][/i][/u] Uses your third spell[/*]
[*][u][i][b]Q+4[/b][/i][/u] Uses your fourth spell[/*]
[*][u][i][b]Q+5[/b][/i][/u] Uses your fifth spell[/*]
[/list]

[list]
[*][size=3]Level 5: Student - Increases your spell upgrade points by +2.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Adept - Increases your spell upgrade points by +2 (for a total of 4!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Scholar - Increase your spell slots to 5.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 5: Acolyte - +0.5 mana regen per level.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Spiritualist - +1 mana regen per level, stacks with Acolyte's mana regen.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Level 10: Mystic - Gain +100 max mana.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=3]

[size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the WizardrySkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.
[b][i][u]This mod includes the manabar API, I do not know how this will interact with other mods that also have a manabar. [/u][/i][/b]

[size=5]Like all spacecore skills, this mod runs into issues with split-screen co-op. It is not made for split-screen co-op.[/size]
